metadata.proof: SOURCE: reset_password endpoint changes the password hash. SINK: No token revocation mechanism. The JWT payload (auth.py line 28) contains only {'sub': user_id, 'role': role_value, 'exp': expiry} — there is no token version ID (jti), issued-at (iat), or token version claim that could be checked against a revocation list. An attacker who stole a JWT before the password reset retains valid access for the token's remaining lifetime (up to 480 minutes / 8 hours by default from ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES).

metadata.proof: SOURCE: require_staff user calls list_users with optional filters. SINK: query.all() returns every User row plus joined Organization data into a single response with no offset or limit pagination. Combined with no rate limiting, an attacker authenticated as support_agent can repeatedly request all users, loading the entire users table into application memory and straining database connections.
